svg.title: The clip editor's strip, labelled
svg.desc: The clip editor's strip with In selected. Twelve labels identify the fighters, playback target, timeline, handles and controls.
svg.text: A frame of the scrub clip with In selected. The strip sits over the bottom of the screen; the game runs above it.
What is open: Crop on a macro, or the Replay window on a capture.
Where X plays the preview: Player 1 or the CPU. A ZR tap swaps it.
The kept part: In, Out, how many frames and seconds are kept, and the take's length.
The move at the selected handle, and how far into it the handle sits.
Grey: frames of the take outside the kept part.
The In handle. L selects it; Left/Right move it; Y snaps it to a move's start.
Red: the kept part, from In to Out.
Out: the first frame not kept. R selects the handle; Y snaps it.
A tick: a move starts here.
A band above the line: a move, from its start to its end, when the end is known.
What the selected handle does, and how to move it faster.
Key hints for the current selection.
Selecting In shows the first kept frame; selecting Out shows the last kept frame (Out minus one).
